title: oreogrammitis leonardii

This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in Africa, where it has been employed to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oreogrammitis leonardii include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
